lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are organized into approximately 7-8 vertical columns posterior to the gills. Columns contain 3-5 nodes each, with vertical spacing between centroids increasing toward the ventral surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary spot columns, forming a visible rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, defined by a high-intensity dorsal margin and a shadow-caste ventral margin.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region displays a high-density labyrinthine pattern of micro-spots and interconnected linear filigree, distinct from the grid pattern on the flank.
